memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "This day I call the heavens and the earth as witnesses against you that I have set before you life and death, blessings and curses. Now choose life, so that you and your children may live and that you may love the Lord your God, listen to his voice, and hold fast to him. For the Lord is your life, and he will give you many years in the land he swore to give to your ancestors, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob." — Deut 30:19-20 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Here is the great climax of the whole chapter, indeed of much of Deuteronomy: "Now choose life." With heaven and earth as witnesses, Moses pleads with the people to choose the path of life. And then comes one of the most beautiful phrases in all of Scripture, revealing what life truly is: "For the Lord is your life." Life is not ultimately found in the land, the harvest, or long years. Life is found in God Himself. He is the life.

This reframes everything. To "choose life" is not merely to pick the better set of circumstances; it is to choose God, to love Him, to listen to His voice, and to "hold fast to him." He is not a means to a good life — He is the life. To have Him is to have everything; to lose Him is to lose all.

How this longing is answered in Jesus. He declared, "I have come that they may have life, and have it to the full" (John 10:10). In Him, God offers us not just a longer earthly life, but eternal life — life that begins now and never ends, life that is knowing God Himself (John 17:3).

So today, the same call echoes to you: choose life. Choose God. Love Him, listen to His voice, and hold fast to Him, "for the Lord is your life." Every other choice fades in importance next to this one. Cling to Him who is your very life, and you will never be truly lost.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do I treasure God as my very life, or only as a means to a good life?
2. What does it mean for me to "hold fast" to God today?
3. Have I chosen the eternal life offered in Christ?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, You are my life — not merely the giver of good things, but life itself. Today I choose You. Help me love You, listen to Your voice, and hold fast to You forever. Thank You for life in Christ. Amen.
